cohort: 450 women with high-risk pregnancies from health centers in Ahvaz, Iran
finding: The quality of perinatal care for women with high-risk pregnancies in Ahvaz, Iran, during the COVID-19 pandemic was moderate overall, with a need for improvement in areas such as education, counseling, and partograph use.
mod_finding: The quality of perinatal care was significantly related to the proportion of elective cesarean sections and preterm delivery.
